areas.how: Skill docs are plain Markdown edited directly: skills/quento/SKILL.md carries YAML front matter (name, description, triggers) and is the source of truth; README.md and install.md are the public docs. Nothing generates pages or articles from them.
The repository holds no image files and no image pipeline; README.md only embeds a remote YouTube thumbnail by URL, and no build step copies or converts images.
No automated test suite and no CI config: AGENTS.md says to verify through an OAuth-capable MCP client connected to https://quento.app/mcp, calling a read-only tool such as list_invoices_tool.
